messages.text: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Signaling / Non-signaling Tester in AI, and what evidence supports each opportunity?

Based on current vault evidence, the strongest **Signaling / Non-signaling Tester** opportunities in AI are **indirect but actionable**: the vault supports AI/data-center demand and separately supports CMX500/CMP180 capabilities for high-throughput Wi‑Fi/cellular device R&D and production. I do **not** see strong vault evidence that directly says “AI customers are buying CMX500/CMP180”; the strongest links are via AI-driven connectivity, edge devices, APs, and production test needs.

## 1) Wi‑Fi 7 / Wi‑Fi 8 AP and device test for AI edge + AI data-center connectivity

**Why it is strong**  
AI workloads increase demand for high-throughput, low-latency connectivity. The tester opportunity is strongest where AI systems need Wi‑Fi 7/next-gen WLAN modules, access points, gateways, or client devices validated in R&D and scaled into production.

**Relevant R&S fit**
- **CMX500**: R&D signaling tester for Wi‑Fi 7, cellular + non-cellular single-box testing.
- **CMP180**: production / R&D non-signaling RF tester for Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, 5G NR FR1, high bandwidth, MIMO, and future Wi‑Fi 8 waveform exploration.

**Evidence from vault**
- The Wi‑Fi 7 test source says R&S positions the solution as **CMX500 for R&D signaling/interworking** and **CMP180 for production non-signaling RF test**. It states CMX500 adds integrated Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality and can test cellular and non-cellular standards in a single instrument setup. It also lists Wi‑Fi 7 features relevant to AI connectivity: **320 MHz channel bandwidth, up to 16 spatial streams, 4096 QAM, low latency and high throughput**. Citation: `wiki/sources/Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024.md`, sections 2–3.
- The same source says CMP180 supports **Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz**, with **bandwidths up to 500 MHz**, and demonstrates **480 MHz WLAN waveform loopback** as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn waveform candidate. Citation: `wiki/concepts/Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing.md`, section 4; `wiki/sources/Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024.md`, section 2.
- The AI/data-center evidence says the vault has an AI/data-center infrastructure concept built around **Enabling AI, Connectivity, Power, Resilience**, and a data-center connectivity portfolio covering electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power, cooling and leak detection. Citation: `wiki/concepts/AI 資料中心基礎設施.md`, sections 9–10; `wiki/concepts/Data center full-spectrum connectivity.md`, section 1.

**Opportunity statement**  
Target companies building **AI edge gateways, Wi‑Fi 7/8 APs, AI laptops/clients, industrial AI devices, and AI data-center connectivity products** with a combined story: CMX500 for protocol/signaling/interworking validation and CMP180 for high-throughput non-signaling production RF test.

---

## 2) High-volume production test for Wi‑Fi 7 / 5G NR modules used in AI-enabled devices

**Why it is strong**  
The clearest non-signaling tester opportunity is production efficiency. AI devices and edge systems need wireless modules; production lines need fast RF testing, not full signaling test.

**Relevant R&S fit**
- **CMP180** optimized for WLAN device production non-signaling RF measurements.
- Supports cellular and non-cellular technologies in one tester, which is useful for combo modules.

**Evidence from vault**
- The vault states that in WLAN device production, **all RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time**, and CMP180 is “optimized for this purpose.” Citation: `wiki/concepts/Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing.md`, section 4.
- CMP180 has **two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports** integrated, supporting **2x2 MIMO** in one box; two CMP180s can be combined for **4x4 MIMO access point** testing. Citation: `wiki/concepts/Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing.md`, section 4; `wiki/sources/Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024.md`, section 2.
- CMP180 specification evidence says IF bandwidth is **250 MHz basic** and **500 MHz with R&S CMP-K185**, and extended frequency range to **6–8 GHz** requires R&S CMP-K168. Citation: `wiki/entities/R&S CMP180.md`, section 8.

**Opportunity statement**  
Position CMP180 with AI-device ODMs/OEMs and module makers as a **production-line throughput tool** for Wi‑Fi 7 / 5G NR FR1 combo connectivity modules, especially where MIMO and 6 GHz / 8 GHz coverage matter.

---

## 3) Cellular + Wi‑Fi interworking for AI edge devices, enterprise AI, and private-network endpoints

**Why it is strong**  
AI edge devices often combine cellular and WLAN connectivity. The vault evidence supports CMX500 as a single-box platform for testing cellular/non-cellular standards, WLAN offload, N3IWF, and voice quality. The AI linkage is again indirect, but the technical fit is strong for connected AI endpoints.

**Relevant R&S fit**
- **CMX500** for signaling-mode validation of real-world RF behavior, MLO, MIMO, coexistence, and end-to-end interworking.
- Useful for devices that move traffic between 5G and Wi‑Fi, such as enterprise AI endpoints, robots, AR/VR, gateways, or industrial handhelds.

**Evidence from vault**
- CMX500 is described as a **multi-technology, multi-channel signaling tester** with integrated Wi‑Fi 7 functionality for R&D engineers to test cellular and non-cellular standards in a single setup. Citation: `wiki/sources/Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024.md`, section 2.
- CMX500 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D scenarios include **signaling mode, real-world RF TX/RX characteristics, MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E test capabilities**. Citation: same source, section 2.
- The source also says CMX500 demonstrates **5G and WLAN traffic offloading / interworking**, with newly integrated **N3IWF** gateway for WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN and integrated **POLQA** voice quality measurement. Citation: same source, sections 2–3.

**Opportunity statement**  
Target AI edge/enterprise device teams that must prove robust **5G + Wi‑Fi 7 coexistence, offload, and end-to-end behavior**, using CMX500 in R&D before handing production RF testing to CMP180.

---

## 4) Forward-looking Wi‑Fi 8 / wider-bandwidth WLAN validation for AI infrastructure

**Why it is strong**  
AI connectivity will likely push bandwidth and latency requirements upward. The vault has explicit evidence that R&S is already showing 480 MHz WLAN waveform validation on CMP180 as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 candidate, though the source cautions Wi‑Fi 8 is not yet defined.

**Relevant R&S fit**
- CMP180 bandwidth and MIMO architecture create an upgrade/early-evaluation path for future WLAN designs.
- CMX500/CMP180 pairing supports R&D-to-production continuity.

**Evidence from vault**
- CMP180 demonstrated **480 MHz bandwidth WLAN waveform loopback**, described as a potential waveform candidate for yet-to-be-defined **Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn**. Citation: `wiki/concepts/Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing.md`, section 4.
- The same evidence warns Wi‑Fi 8 is **yet-to-be-defined**, so this is a future-facing opportunity, not a standards-compliant Wi‑Fi 8 production claim. Citation: same section.
- CMP180 bandwidth support up to **500 MHz** is also cited from product/spec evidence. Citation: `wiki/entities/R&S CMP180.md`, section 8.

**Opportunity statement**  
Use CMP180 as a conversation starter with advanced AP/chipset/module teams working on post-Wi‑Fi 7 bandwidth requirements for AI connectivity, while clearly positioning this as **pre-standard / exploratory** rather than formal Wi‑Fi 8 compliance.

---

## 5) AI server ecosystem is a broader account-entry signal, but less directly tied to CMX/CMP

**Why it is weaker but still useful**  
The AI server evidence in the vault is strong for **PCB, high-speed interconnect, power, optical, and data-center infrastructure**. It does not directly map CMX500/CMP180 into AI server manufacturing. However, it helps identify accounts and ecosystems where R&S can cross-sell connectivity testers when those companies also build wireless modules, gateways, APs, or edge AI devices.

**Evidence from vault**
- AI server PCB evidence says AI server trends push PCBs toward **higher layer count, larger area and high-speed transmission**, with supply-chain upgrades; it also cites GB200/GB300/VR200 board upgrades and future platform timing. Citation: `wiki/concepts/AI 伺服器 PCB 供應鏈升級.md`, sections 2 and 4.
- The R&S AI server ecosystem mapping page is explicitly described as a **sales/test solution mapping** from an Excel table, not formal product configuration, customer relationship, or verified opportunity. Citation: `wiki/concepts/AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping.md`, sections 1 and 8.
- The data-center portfolio evidence covers AI/data-center **high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling and leak detection**. Citation: `wiki/concepts/Data center full-spectrum connectivity.md`, section 1.

**Opportunity statement**  
Use AI server/data-center evidence primarily for **account prioritization and ecosystem mapping**, not as direct proof of CMX/CMP demand. The direct CMX/CMP pitch should be attached to wireless/connectivity products inside or around that ecosystem.

---

## Bottom line ranking

1. **Wi‑Fi 7 / Wi‑Fi 8 AP and device R&D + production test** — strongest direct tester fit; CMX500 + CMP180 evidence is strong.  
2. **High-volume non-signaling production test for Wi‑Fi 7 / 5G combo modules** — strongest CMP180-specific opportunity.  
3. **5G + Wi‑Fi interworking/offload for AI edge and enterprise devices** — strong CMX500 technical fit, AI linkage indirect.  
4. **Pre-standard Wi‑Fi 8 / 480 MHz WLAN exploration** — forward-looking, useful for chipset/AP innovators; must be framed carefully.  
5. **AI server/data-center ecosystem accounts** — strong AI market evidence, but weak direct linkage to signaling/non-signaling testers unless the account also owns wireless/connectivity products.

RAW 明確稱 CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant 是 AI-powered tool for the CMX500 5G one-box signaling tester，可簡化並加速 test engineers 的 script generation [25]。

WIKI 稱 CMP180 在 MWC 展示 480 MHz WLAN waveform loopback，並稱其是 yet-to-be-defined Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn 的 potential waveform candidate [10]。

- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將在 [[MWC 2024]] 展示最新 [[Wi-Fi 7]] R&D 與 production 測試方案，用於應對 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]、[[LTE]] 與 [[5G]] parallel operation 的測試挑戰。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality，可讓 R&D engineers 以 single instrument setup 測試 cellular 與 non-cellular standards。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 的 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D 測試情境包含 signaling mode、real-world RF TX/RX characteristics、[[MLO]]、multiple RF chains、2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 也被用於展示 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 traffic offloading / interworking；來源稱其 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway 可測試 [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]，並搭配 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被描述為 production phase 的 non-signaling RF measurement tester，支援 cellular 與 non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將在 MWC 展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform；來源稱這是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 來源說法：two analyzers、two generators、two sets of eight RF ports integrated，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing；兩台 CMP180 可 combined / scaled，支援 four analyzers and generators，用於 4x4 MIMO access points。
- 展示地點：Fira Gran Via, Barcelona，hall 5，booth 5A80。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
- 公司段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 在 2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，且 2025-06-30 有 more than 15,000 employees worldwide。

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。

- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。

R&S CMP180 › Frequency range 與 bandwidth

- IF bandwidth：基本 **250 MHz**；requires **R&S CMP-K185** 為 **500 MHz**。
- **R&S CMP-K185** ordering information：only available if **R&S CMP-B805I or higher option** is installed。

cited_passages.text: In the production phase of WLAN devices, all RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time. Rohde & Schwarz has optimized the [R&S CMP180](https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/us/products/test-and-measurement/wireless-tester-rf-analyzer-generator/cmp180-radio-communication-tester_63493-1081280.html "CMP180") radio communication tester for this purpose. The instrument supports many cellular and non-cellular technologies including Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz in frequency with bandwidths up to 500 MHz. Leveraging the wide bandwidth, the R&S CMP180 will demonstrate at MWC its ability to verify a WLAN waveform with 480 MHz bandwidth in loopback mode, a potential waveform candidate for the yet-to-be-defined Wi-Fi 8 (IEEE 802.11bn) standard. This feature shows that the cost-effective instrument is future-proof for users not only in production, but also in R&D.
